name: shared-service-ownership
goal: Only services with two distinct runtime consumers appear in Services; single-consumer implementations live beside their owner while public contracts and registered identities remain stable

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Require two distinct actual runtime owner units for Services inclusion and Used In links. Colocate all 195 initially confirmed private service capabilities with their owners, preserving identities, implementations and public entries.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standardized catalog and card-grid suites accepted a single-consumer service and indirect page fallback. Extend their shared fixtures with zero, one, duplicate, missing and shared owners; extend metadata and source-move coverage with service cases and a frozen relocation ledger.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
